verdict.rationale: Extensive first-party docs and SDK references (Python, JS/Go) show one-call sandbox creation (`Sandbox.create`), fast spin-up ('seconds', 'hundreds of thousands of concurrent rollout environments in seconds'), custom images, GPU attachment, and live command execution, corroborated by independent community builds using Modal Sandboxes for real workloads (CI runners, agent runtimes). Missing for 10: independent benchmark of actual cold-start latency and no formal API spec (OpenAPI 404) to verify single-call simplicity claims.
